vibe_rationale: Closest Portuguese peer to SURPLUS: gallery-curated, multi-format and community-led, with brands woven in through exclusive releases.
fit_notes: A recovery or wellbeing space and a community projects strand give High Ground a culture-first way in, and Galp and Fundação Millennium bcp are already involved. As an Australian brand, High Ground would need a local partner or travel to Lisbon.
